      | Priority.Normal => true

definition{
  name: ordering_is_Less,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => true
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => false
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => false)
}

definition{
  name: ordering_is_Equal,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => false
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => true
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => false)
}

definition{
  name: ordering_is_Greater,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => false
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => false
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => true)
}

definition{
  name: reverse_Ordering,
  parameters: [value : CmpOrdering],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match value
    | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
}

definition{
  name: compare_Priority,
  parameters: [left : Priority, right : Priority],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match left
    | Priority.Low => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Priority.Normal => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Priority.Urgent => (match right
      | Priority.Low => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Normal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Priority.Urgent => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)))
}

theorem{
  name: compare_Priority_reflexive,
  parameters: [a : Priority],
  statement: ((compare_Priority a a) = (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)),
  proof: cases{
    branches: [
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
      {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
    ],
    scrutinee: a
  }
}

theorem{
  name: compare_Priority_antisymmetric,
  parameters: [a : Priority, b : Priority],
  statement: ((compare_Priority a b) = (reverse_Ordering (compare_Priority b a))),
  proof: cases{
    branches: [
      {
        proof: cases{
          branches: [
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
          ],
          scrutinee: b
        },
        binders: [],
        constructor: Low
      },
      {
        proof: cases{
          branches: [
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
          ],
          scrutinee: b
        },
        binders: [],
        constructor: Normal
      },
      {
        proof: cases{
          branches: [
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Normal},
            {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Urgent}
          ],
          scrutinee: b
        },
        binders: [],
        constructor: Urgent
      }
    ],
    scrutinee: a
  }
}

                  {proof: reflexivity{}, binders: [], constructor: Low},

                ],

definition{
  name: compare_String,
  parameters: [left : String, right : String],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (if (prim less_than left right : Bool) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Less) else (if (prim equal left right : Bool) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal) else (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: compare_Request,
  parameters: [left : Request, right : Request],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match (compare_Priority (project left priority) (project right priority))
    | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => (match (compare_String (project left room) (project right room))
      | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: compare_Zone,
  parameters: [left : Zone, right : Zone],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match left
    | Zone.Room x0 => (match right
      | Zone.Room y0 => (match (compare_String x0 y0)
        | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
        | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
        | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
      | Zone.Group y0 => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | Zone.Group x0 => (match right
      | Zone.Room y0 => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | Zone.Group y0 => (match (compare_ListZone x0 y0)
        | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
        | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
        | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  mutual: CompareOfZone,
  recursive_argument: left
}

definition{
  name: compare_ListZone,
  parameters: [left : (List Zone), right : (List Zone)],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match left
    | List.nil => (match right
      | List.nil => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | List.cons y0 y1 => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less))
    | List.cons x0 x1 => (match right
      | List.nil => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)
      | List.cons y0 y1 => (match (compare_Zone x0 y0)
        | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
        | CmpOrdering.Equal => (match (compare_ListZone x1 y1)
          | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
          | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
          | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
        | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  mutual: CompareOfZone,
  recursive_argument: left
}

definition{
  name: compare_Nat,
  parameters: [left : Nat, right : Nat],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (if (left <? right) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Less) else (if (left =? right) then (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal) else (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater)))
}

definition{
  name: compare_TuplePriorityNat,
  parameters: [left : TuplePriorityNat, right : TuplePriorityNat],
  result: CmpOrdering,
  body: (match (compare_Priority (project left item0) (project right item0))
    | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
    | CmpOrdering.Equal => (match (compare_Nat (project left item1) (project right item1))
      | CmpOrdering.Less => (ctor CmpOrdering.Less)
      | CmpOrdering.Equal => (ctor CmpOrdering.Equal)
      | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
    | CmpOrdering.Greater => (ctor CmpOrdering.Greater))
}

definition{
  name: width,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (if ((project band low) <=? (project band high)) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim subtract (project band high) (project band low) : Nat)) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
}

definition{
  name: checkedMidpoint,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (match (if (((project band low) + (project band high)) <? 4294967296) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] ((project band low) + (project band high))) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
    | Option.none => (ctor Option.none [Nat])
    | Option.some sum => (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim quotient sum 2 0 : Nat)))
}

definition{
  name: tick,
  parameters: [counter : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (prim remainder (counter + 1) 256 0 : Nat)
}

definition{
  name: shortfall,
  parameters: [band : Band, current : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (prim subtract (project band low) current : Nat)
}

definition{
  name: freezing,
  parameters: [outdoor : Int64],
  result: Bool,
  body: (not (prim less_than (0 : Int64) outdoor : Bool)),
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
  name: delta,
  parameters: [before : Int64, after : Int64],
  result: (Option Int64),
  body: (prim checked_subtract after before : (Option Int64))
}

definition{
  name: checkedValue,
  parameters: [band : Band],
  result: TupleBandBool,
  body: (record TupleBandBool {item0 := band, item1 := ((project band low) <=? (project band high))})
}

definition{
  name: isCelsius,
  parameters: [unit : String],
  result: Bool,
  body: ((prim equal unit "C" : Bool) || (prim equal unit "celsius" : Bool))
}

definition{
  name: above,
  parameters: [readings : (List Nat), target : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match readings
    | List.nil => 0
    | List.cons firstValue1 rest => (if (target <? firstValue1) then (if (((above rest target) + 1) <? 4294967296) then ((above rest target) + 1) else 4294967295) else (above rest target))),
  recursive_argument: readings
}

definition{
  name: firstReading,
  parameters: [readings : (List Nat)],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (prim index readings 0 : (Option Nat))
}

definition{
  name: targetOr,
  parameters: [setting : (Option Nat), default : Nat],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match setting | Option.none => default | Option.some value1 => value1)
}

definition{
  name: heatFor,
  parameters: [band : (Result Band ConfigError), current : Nat],
  result: (Result Bool ConfigError),
  body: (match band
    | Result.ok band1 => (ctor Result.ok [Bool, ConfigError] (current <? (project band1 low)))
    | Result.error error1 => (ctor Result.error [Bool, ConfigError] error1))
}

definition{
  name: fanLabel,
  parameters: [speed : Nat],
  result: String,
  body: (if (speed =? 0) then "off" else (if ((speed =? 1) || (speed =? 2)) then "low" else "high"))
}

definition{
  name: labelled,
  parameters: [value : String, unit : String],
  result: String,
  body: (prim join (cons value (cons " " (cons unit (nil String)))) "" : String),
  axioms: [propext]
}

definition{
  name: lowOf,
  parameters: [band : (Result Band ConfigError)],
  result: (Result Nat ConfigError),
  body: (match band
    | Result.ok band1 => (ctor Result.ok [Nat, ConfigError] (project band1 low))
    | Result.error error1 => (ctor Result.error [Nat, ConfigError] error1))
}

definition{
  name: notANumber,
  parameters: [error : ConfigError],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match error | ConfigError.Unreadable => false | ConfigError.NotANumber => true)
}

definition{
  name: withHigh,
  parameters: [band : Band, high : Nat],
  result: Band,
  body: (record Band {low := (project band low), high := high})
}

definition{
  name: withLow,
  parameters: [band : Band, low : Nat],
  result: Band,
  body: (let out : Band := band; (let out1 : Band := (record Band {low := low, high := (project out high)}); out1))
}

definition{
  name: joined,
  parameters: [firstValueArg : (List Nat), secondValue : (List Nat)],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (let out : (List Nat) := firstValueArg; (let out1 : (List Nat) := (prim append out secondValue : (List Nat)); out1))
}

definition{name: labelOf, parameters: [view : Labelled], result: String, body: (project view label)}

definition{

theorem{
  name: decreases_everyOtherLoop1_0,
  parameters: [at1 : Nat, state1 : (List String), rooms : (List String)],
  statement: (((at1 <? (prim length rooms : Nat)) = true) -> ((prim subtract (prim length rooms : Nat) (at1 + 2) : Nat) < (prim subtract (prim length rooms : Nat) at1 : Nat))),
  proof: linear_arithmetic{},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: everyOtherLoop1,
  parameters: [at1 : Nat, state1 : (List String), rooms : (List String)],
  result: TupleNatListString,
  body: (if (at1 <? (prim length rooms : Nat)) then (everyOtherLoop1 (at1 + 2) (everyOtherStep1 at1 state1 rooms) rooms) else (record TupleNatListString {item0 := at1, item1 := state1})),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  termination: {
    evidence: [decreases_everyOtherLoop1_0],
    measure: (prim subtract (prim length rooms : Nat) at1 : Nat)
  }
}

definition{
  name: everyOther,
  parameters: [rooms : (List String)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (let out : (List String) := (nil String); (let atValue : Nat := 0; (let state2 : TupleNatListString := (everyOtherLoop1 atValue out rooms); (let atValue2 : Nat := (project state2 item0); (let out2 : (List String) := (project state2 item1); out2))))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{

definition{

  body: (if (at1 <? (prim length rooms : Nat)) then (let out1 : (List String) := (prim append state1 (cons (firstRoomsPart1 at1 rooms) (nil String)) : (List String)); (let atValue1 : Nat := (at1 + 1); out1)) else (let atValue2 : Nat := (at1 + 1); state1))
}

theorem{
  name: decreases_firstRoomsLoop1_0,
  parameters: [at1 : Nat, state1 : (List String), count : Nat, rooms : (List String)],
  statement: (((at1 <? count) = true) -> ((prim subtract count (at1 + 1) : Nat) < (prim subtract count at1 : Nat))),

}

definition{
  name: firstRoomsLoop1,
  parameters: [at1 : Nat, state1 : (List String), count : Nat, rooms : (List String)],

}

definition{

theorem{

  parameters: [plan : Plan, inner : Plan],

definition{

    | Plan.Room name => (ctor Option.some [String] name)
    | Plan.Wing value => (ctor Option.none [String])
    | Plan.Annex inner => (annexedRoom inner)),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  termination: {evidence: [decreases_annexedRoom_0], measure: (size_of_Plan plan)}
}

definition{

    | List.nil => (nil String)

}

theorem{
  name: decreases_occupiedTarget_0,
  parameters: [step : Step, occupied : Step, rest : Step],
  statement: ((step = (ctor Step.Either occupied rest)) -> ((size_of_Step occupied) < (size_of_Step step))),
  proof: linear_arithmetic{definitions: [size_of_Step]},
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: occupiedTarget,
  parameters: [step : Step],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (match step
    | Step.Hold target => (ctor Option.some [Nat] target)
    | Step.Either occupied rest => (occupiedTarget occupied)
    | Step.Sequence value => (ctor Option.none [Nat])),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext],
  termination: {evidence: [decreases_occupiedTarget_0], measure: (size_of_Step step)}
}

definition{
  name: isSequence,
  parameters: [step : Step],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match step
    | Step.Hold value => false
    | Step.Either value rest => false
    | Step.Sequence value => true)
}

definition{

definition{

  parameters: [phase : Phase],
  result: String,

definition{

  parameters: [menu : Menu],
  result: Bool,
  body: (match menu | Menu.Choose value => true | Menu.Submenu value => false)
}

definition{
  name: labelOr,
  parameters: [phase : Phase, fallback : String],
  result: String,
  body: (if (prim equal (field_Phase_label phase) "" : Bool) then fallback else (field_Phase_label phase))
}

definition{
  name: labelsInsert1,
  parameters: [items1 : (List String), item1 : String],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match items1
    | List.nil => (cons item1 (nil String))
    | List.cons head1 rest1 => (if (prim equal item1 head1 : Bool) then (cons head1 rest1) else (if (prim less_than item1 head1 : Bool) then (cons item1 (cons head1 rest1)) else (cons head1 (labelsInsert1 rest1 item1))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items1
}

definition{
  name: labelsLoop1,
  parameters: [items2 : (List Phase), state1 : (List String)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (match items2
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons phase rest2 => (let out1 : (List String) := (labelsInsert1 state1 (field_Phase_label phase)); (labelsLoop1 rest2 out1))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items2
}

definition{
  name: labels,
  parameters: [phases : (List Phase)],
  result: (List String),
  body: (let out : (List String) := (nil String); (let state2 : (List String) := (labelsLoop1 phases out); state2)),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: heldTargetsPart1,
  parameters: [phase : Phase],
  result: Nat,
  body: (match (occupiedTarget (field_Phase_step phase))
    | Option.none => 0
    | Option.some value1 => value1),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: heldTargetsInsert1,
  parameters: [items1 : (List TupleStringNat), item1 : TupleStringNat],
  result: (List TupleStringNat),
  body: (match items1
    | List.nil => (cons item1 (nil TupleStringNat))
    | List.cons head1 rest1 => (if (prim equal (project item1 item0) (project head1 item0) : Bool) then (cons item1 rest1) else (if (prim less_than (project item1 item0) (project head1 item0) : Bool) then (cons item1 (cons head1 rest1)) else (cons head1 (heldTargetsInsert1 rest1 item1))))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items1
}

definition{
  name: heldTargetsLoop1,
  parameters: [items2 : (List Phase), state1 : (List TupleStringNat)],
  result: (List TupleStringNat),
  body: (match items2
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons phase rest2 => (let out1 : (List TupleStringNat) := (heldTargetsInsert1 state1 (record TupleStringNat {item0 := (field_Phase_label phase), item1 := (heldTargetsPart1 phase)})); (heldTargetsLoop1 rest2 out1))),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext],
  recursive_argument: items2
}

definition{
  name: heldTargets,
  parameters: [phases : (List Phase)],

  body: (let out : (List TupleStringNat) := (nil TupleStringNat); (let state2 : (List TupleStringNat) := (heldTargetsLoop1 phases out); state2)),
  axioms: [Classical.choice, Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{

definition{

definition{
  name: firstHold,
  parameters: [step : Step],
  result: (Option Nat),
  body: (match step
    | Step.Hold value => (if (value =? 0) then (ctor Option.none [Nat]) else (let other : Step := (ctor Step.Hold value); (occupiedTarget other)))
    | Step.Either value other => (if (isSequence other) then (ctor Option.none [Nat]) else (let other1 : Step := (ctor Step.Either value other); (occupiedTarget other1)))
    | Step.Sequence value => (let other : Step := (ctor Step.Sequence value); (occupiedTarget other))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}

definition{
  name: singleLabel,
  parameters: [phases : (List Phase)],
  result: (Option String),
  body: (match phases
    | List.nil => (ctor Option.none [String])
    | List.cons value rest => (match (field_Phase_step value)
      | Step.Hold value1 => (match rest
        | List.nil => (let label : String := (field_Phase_label value); (ctor Option.some [String] label))
        | List.cons value2 rest1 => (ctor Option.none [String]))
      | Step.Either value3 rest2 => (ctor Option.none [String])
      | Step.Sequence value4 => (ctor Option.none [String])))
}

definition{

definition{
  name: atLeastLoop1,
  parameters: [items1 : (List Nat), state1 : (List Nat), floor : Nat],
  result: (List Nat),
  body: (match items1
    | List.nil => state1
    | List.cons r rest1 => (match (if (floor <=? r) then (ctor Option.some [Nat] (prim subtract r floor : Nat)) else (ctor Option.none [Nat]))
      | Option.none => (atLeastLoop1 rest1 state1 floor)
      | Option.some kept => (let out1 : (List Nat) := (prim append state1 (cons kept (nil Nat)) : (List Nat)); (atLeastLoop1 rest1 out1 floor)))),
  recursive_argument: items1
}

definition{

}

  parameters: [phase : Phase],

  body: (let target : Nat := (describePart1 phase); (let sequence : Bool := (isSequence (field_Phase_step phase)); (prim join (cons (field_Phase_label phase) (cons ": " (cons (Prelude::natDecimal target) (cons (heldUnit) (cons " (sequence: " (cons (if sequence then "true" else "false") (cons ")" (nil String)))))))) "" : String))),
  axioms: [Quot.sound, propext]
}
